pull.body:
Fixes dev-skill-up/pitboss#462

Head: 6673d4ad3a0318f2e5d6f45656c6cb05bfeefc22

Done-when digest: 97d51d9eabaf0ce0

## Plan

Each Done-when item of #462 word for word, with its evidence; the command rows first, the CI pointers last.

1. The head: `git rev-parse HEAD`.
2. Done when 1: A PR whose newest `Opus ruling` comment rules `do these steps` is offered the review step, not the fix step, when its body was edited after the ruling comment and a `Plan check` comment saying `Plan check: ok` for the PR's current head and Plan digest is newer than the ruling. A test plants that world and shows the review step. CI pointer: workflow `pr-main.yml`, job `tests`, step `Run Nox`, greppable `test_a_clean_check_after_the_ruling_gives_the_review` (the flow gives the review step); the tests of the functions it changed, `test_a_clean_check_before_the_ruling_is_not_since` (`checked_since`, the nearest input it must still reject: a clean check older than the ruling), `test_unchecked_and_review_follow_the_check` (`unchecked`, `review`) and `test_plan_unrun_needs_a_review_after_the_ruling` (`plan_unrun`); the run of the head is https://github.com/dev-skill-up/pitboss/actions/runs/43011137593, the page of its `tests-3.13` entry is https://github.com/dev-skill-up/pitboss/actions/runs/43011137593/job/130490739619.
3. Done when 2: The same PR is still offered the fix step when the body was not edited after the ruling, and when the Plan check after the ruling is a refusal. A test plants each. CI pointer: workflow `pr-main.yml`, job `tests`, step `Run Nox`, greppable `test_no_check_after_the_ruling_gives_the_fix` and `test_a_refusal_after_the_ruling_gives_the_fix` (and `test_a_clean_check_of_another_plan_gives_the_fix`); same run and page as row 2.
4. Done when 3: `slots next --config CFG --step review OWNER/REPO#N` prints the review brief for that named PR (the brief the sweep prints for a PR at the review step), and exits 1 with `UNKNOWN` plus the PR's actual step when the PR is not at the review step. A test plants a PR at each of the steps and shows the output or the refusal. CI pointer: workflow `pr-main.yml`, job `tests`, step `Run Nox`, greppable `test_a_pr_at_the_review_is_briefed` (output), `test_a_pr_at_a_fix_is_refused_with_its_step_and_the_rule`, `test_a_pr_at_another_step_is_refused` and `test_a_ticket_is_at_no_review` (the refusals, status 1, `UNKNOWN` and the step); same run and page as row 2.
5. Done when 4: The refusal and the help text of `--step` state the rule, so a user who asks for a step that the PR is not at sees why. CI pointer: workflow `pr-main.yml`, job `tests`, step `Run Nox`, greppable `test_a_pr_at_a_fix_is_refused_with_its_step_and_the_rule` (the refusal says `--step review prints the brief of a PR only when its step is a review`); the help text is the same sentence, `itemfast.STEP_RULE`, in `itemfast.STEP_ARGUMENT`; same run and page as row 2.

## Execution

- `plancheckflow.checked_since` says whether the newest trusted check of the Plan as it is now is clean and newer than the newest readable ruling; `flow.ruled_step` takes the second step of the `do these steps` row of `AFTER` (the review) when it is, else the first (the fix). GitHub gives no time for a body edit (`bodydigest`), so the clean `Plan check` after the ruling is the record that the body was edited after it. The `Plan check` comment records the Plan digest and no head; a push after the ruling already ends `flowstate.ruling_unapplied`, so the head is covered there.
- `itemfast.show_review` (`slots next --step review`) prints the brief only when the pick's kind is one of `brief.REVIEWS`; otherwise it prints `UNKNOWN: REF is not at the review step: its step is `...`; --step review prints the brief of a PR only when its step is a review (...)` on standard error and the command exits 1. A ticket with no PR is refused with the same rule; a reason `slots next` already gives (closed, held, a wait) is kept.
- Local: `pitboss nox` on the head, its four sessions green, in the hand-back; the Plan names no nox run (CI's `Run Nox` step is the suite).

Deviations: none

## Evidence

```pitboss-expand sha256=78e494fc193777dc head=6673d4ad3a0318f2e5d6f45656c6cb05bfeefc22
$ git rev-parse HEAD
6673d4ad3a0318f2e5d6f45656c6cb05bfeefc22
```
